# WeatherRing

> 24-hour climate ring for round Wear OS 6+ watches, with an Android companion.

- Canonical: https://weatherring.net
- How to read: https://weatherring.net/how-to-read
- Privacy: https://weatherring.net/privacy/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.climatedayring.phone
- Contact: support@weatherring.net

## What it is

WeatherRing is a watch face for round Wear OS 6+ displays. The rim is today’s forecast from midnight to midnight, with midnight at the bottom and noon at the top. Color shows temperature, and the hand points to the current hour.

Current version: 1.1.

Layers on the ring: night veil, sky glow, rain, snow, thunder, fog. Rain, snow and lightning sit on top of the sky glow — they never replace it. Sky glow is gold for sun and pale for overcast.

The Android phone companion uses the exact same preview rendering as the watch. Customize the face and Always-On Display from the Look tab, with sliders and preset colour choices. Location is optional.

One purchase covers both the phone companion and the Wear OS app. You still install twice.

- Requires Wear OS 6 or newer. The face can be added after the watch app is installed.
- Not compatible with Wear OS 5 or older.

Always-on: choose what stays visible when the watch screen dims. It doesn't change the face when the watch is awake. Toggles: temperature ring, sky glow, precipitation, time, date, center temperatures, city name.

## New in 1.1

- Next days (optional, off by default): today moves to the top half of the ring, and the bottom half shows tomorrow or the next 2 days. Two-letter weekday labels, with each day's low and high curved beside them.
- Complication slot above the time. Shows the watch battery by default: green from 60%, yellow from 20 to 60%, red below 20%. Change it with long-press → Customise → tap the slot.
- Refresh every 1, 2, 3 or 6 hours (Watch tab). Default is every hour. Follow your location uses the same interval.
- Date and weekday letters follow the phone's language. The app's own screens are in English.
- Larger text in the phone app.
- The night veil can leave rain, snow, storms and fog bright at night (Also dim weather off).
- Fixes: watch app crash when falling back to watch GPS, weather refresh on Android 10/11 phones, yesterday's weather after midnight.

No account. No ads. No sale of data.

## How to read

Example — not your city.

- All: Midnight to midnight, with midnight at the bottom of the ring and noon at the top. Color shows temperature, and the hand points to the current hour.
- Now: From midnight to the hand is time that has already passed today. The inner and outer lines are the same mark.
- Temperature: Cool hours sit toward blue and violet. Warm hours sit toward orange and red.
- Night: The darker arc is night. It lifts at sunrise and returns at sunset, around 07 and 19 in the example.
- Sky: The glow inside the ring is the sky: gold for sun, pale for overcast, gold and grey stripes when partly cloudy.
- Rain: Streaks on that hour. Longer streaks mean more rain, gaps mean patchy showers.
- Snow: Soft white ticks mean snow or ice, not rain.
- Thunder: Lightning bolts show when thunder is in the forecast, even if the rain is light.
- Fog: A milky band just inside the ring means fog or dense mist. A thicker band means heavier fog.
- Next days (optional): today fills the top half, from 00 on the left through 12 at the top to 24 on the right. The bottom half shows tomorrow, or the next two days, starting on the right. Two letters mark each weekday; with Curved min and max on, that day's low and high sit beside them.
- Slot above the time: watch battery by default, green from 60%, yellow from 20 to 60%, red below 20%.

The three numbers are today's low, the current temperature and today's high. 00 06 12 18 are clock hours.

## Location

Location is optional. Search any city manually, or tap "Use my location" for a quick one-time check. Follow your location is a separate switch (off by default), needs Allow all the time, and updates at the Refresh every interval. Saved cities never run background GPS.

## How to install

1. Install on the phone from Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.climatedayring.phone
2. Install the same app on the watch (tap Install on watch in the phone app).
3. Open once on the watch, set WeatherRing as the face.

Requires Wear OS 6 or newer. Not compatible with Wear OS 5 or older. It also needs a round display.

## What it is not

- Not for Apple Watch.
- Not for rectangular Wear OS.
- Not compatible with Wear OS 5 or older. Requires Wear OS 6 or newer.
- Not a smart ring.
- Not a web clone of the watch face.
- Location is not required.
- Not an account-based product. No ads. Data is not sold.

## Privacy

See https://weatherring.net/privacy/
Forecast coordinates go to weather.weatherring.net (self-hosted Open-Meteo); if that is slow or down, the same coordinates go to WeatherAPI.com as forecast backup. City search uses WeatherAPI.com. Live GPS place name on the phone only uses BigDataCloud. No accounts, no ads, no sale of data.
Last updated: 8 October 2026
